provenance.seed_strategy: base_seed * 1000 + scenario_index * 100 + run_index; fixed across all candidates and generations

metric_definitions.seeds: base_seed * 1000 + scenario_index * 100 + run_index; scenario_index Best=0, Average=1, Worst=2.
metric_definitions.wait: Observed wait for every arrival: service_start - arrival, or window_end - arrival if still waiting (right censored). Empty groups use zero.
metric_definitions.in_treatment: Holding a bed, including post-treatment stay; waiting patients hold no resources.
metric_definitions.throughput: Completed hospital flows per hour of observation.
metric_definitions.utilization: Occupied resource minutes inside [0, window_end) / (capacity * window_minutes).
metric_definitions.allocation: Priority then arrival order among feasible patients; bed, doctor and nurse acquired together. Staff held during treatment, bed during full LOS.
metric_definitions.percentiles: Scenario wait metrics are means of per-run statistics, not pooled patient percentiles.

metric_definitions.in_treatment: Holding a bed, including post-treatment stay; waiting patients hold no resources.
metric_definitions.throughput: Completed hospital flows per hour of observation.
metric_definitions.utilization: Occupied resource minutes inside [0, window_end) / (capacity * window_minutes).
metric_definitions.allocation: Priority then arrival order among feasible patients; bed, doctor and nurse acquired together. Staff held during treatment, bed during full LOS.
metric_definitions.percentiles: Scenario wait metrics are means of per-run statistics, not pooled patient percentiles.
